# CC10: 泽兰堂 Zelan Tang

Wave 3 · Changchun Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=CC10` · Page: `/scenes/#CC10` · Row: `research/buildings/CC10-zelan-tang/`

## What it was

泽兰堂 Zelan Tang, on the south slope of the northern hill, east of 宝相寺 through a walled gate (城关), south of the 大水法 of the Xiyang Lou (S05 j83:12b; E0186, E0187). 日下旧闻考: 翠交轩 with the stone grotto 熙春洞 under it, 爱山楼 north of it (upper plaque 天風海濤, lower 山静雲閒), and 泽兰堂 further north (plaque 神觀蕭爽) (S05 j83:12b). Begun 1746 and known for its rockwork; 泽兰堂, a five-bay hall on a high terrace, and 理性居 were added in 1759; used as a study with the best view over the fountains (E0187). A plan of July 1835 records approval to remove 理性居 and its corridors and fit railings instead (样076-3, E0188): so 理性居 was gone in 1860. Not among the buildings left standing after 1860 (E0451, after 刘敦桢), so it burned in October 1860 (S02 pp.187-188).

From the inventory row: **built** 1746; 泽兰堂 added 1759; **changed** The 西洋水法 stands north of 澤蘭堂; a dated 1795 statement fixing this relation; 1835: 理性居 and its corridors removed, railings fitted; **destroyed** 1860 (S05, S48, S01, S201, S361, S310).

## The scene itself

### The leaf of 1744, its poem and preface

Not one of the Forty Scenes of 1744.

### How later sources differ

1835: 理性居 and its corridors at 泽兰堂 removed and replaced by railings (E0188). The model of 1860 should leave 理性居 out.
